events.title: Brunswick County Planning Board — Public Hearings (Z-947CZ and SS-293)
events.venue: Commissioners’ Chambers, David R. Sandifer Administration Building, 30 Government Center Drive NE, Bolivia, NC 28422
events.description: Brunswick County Planning Board meeting and public hearings. Case Z-947CZ and proposed land-use plan amendment LUM-947 concern approximately 3.48 acres at 10018 Chappell Loop Road SE near Leland, with a request for conditional commercial-intensive zoning to allow a flex-space warehouse and office park. Project SS-293, Heron Bluff Major Subdivision, proposes 172 single-family lots on approximately 80.18 acres at 7255 and 7269 Ridgewood Trail NW and Longwood Road NW (NC 904) near Longwood. A proposed text amendment to Section 5.3.3.C of the County Unified Development Ordinance would add CrossOver Modern Home (CrossMod) in the RR, R-7500, R-6000, NC and C-LD zoning districts. Meeting begins at 4 p.m. in Commissioners' Chambers; end time is not published. Contact Brunswick County Planning at 910-253-2025 for hearing participation details.
events.source_name: Brunswick County official public-hearing notices
events.editor_note: New CrossOver Modern Home text-amendment notice posted October 30: https://brunswickcountync.gov/m/newsflash/Home/Detail/922. Existing notices: Z-947CZ at https://www.brunswickcountync.gov/m/NewsFlash/Home/Detail/917 and SS-293 at https://www.brunswickcountync.gov/m/NewsFlash/Home/Detail/915. events.venue: Various Town of Leland facilities; individual session locations are not published
events.description: Free six-week program introducing participants to Town government, budgeting, public safety, planning and development, public works, and parks and recreation. Sessions are held Wednesdays from 3–5 p.m., January 6 through February 10; this is a weekly program, not a continuous event. Open to people who live within Leland town limits or own a business within town limits. Application required by November 30, 2026; cohort limited to 20 participants. Selected applicants will be notified December 21. Host: Town of Leland.
events.source_name: Town of Leland official Citizens Academy page
